title: vitis-idaea punctata var. minor
intro: Vitis-idaea punctata var. minor, commonly known as the dwarf bilberry or small bilberry, is a type of low-growing, woody shrub native to the Arctic regions. It is rich in antioxidants, vitamins, and minerals, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help protect against oxidative stress and infections. The plant is used in traditional medicine due to its therapeutic actions, including wound healing, antiseptic, and anti-cancer properties, attributed to the presence of bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins. These compounds are responsible for the plant's medicinal effects, making it a valuable resource in the development of new medicines and dietary supplements.
